title: Calendar invites update and cancel in the booker's calendar when a booking moves or is cancelled

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-21: buildBookingIcsBase64 sends METHOD:PUBLISH with no ORGANIZER, ATTENDEE, LOCATION or SEQUENCE. A cancellation mails no .ics, and a reschedule creates a new booking id, so the new invite has a new UID and the old event stays in the booker's calendar next to the new one. Fix: METHOD:REQUEST with a stable UID across a reschedule (carry the first booking id), SEQUENCE bumps, and a METHOD:CANCEL attachment on cancel.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
